I am a cardiologist by training (MD-PhD, "G. d'Annunzio" University of Chieti–Pescara, with doctoral research in Chieti and London) and my research has focused on the diagnostic and prognostic value of cardiovascular magnetic resonance in angina, cardiomyopathies, and heart transplantation.

I now work as a research officer at LSE Health, London School of Economics, where I completed an MSc in Health Economics. My work sits at the intersection of cardiovascular imaging and economic evaluation — asking not only whether a test or treatment works, but whether it is worth using.

### Selected highlights

::: {style="text-align: left;"}
- My [systematic review in JAMA Cardiology](pubs/jamacard2023/index.qmd) is cited in the 2024 ESC Guidelines on chronic coronary syndromes.
- At LSE Health, I develop economic evaluation tools for the EU-funded [HYPERMARKER project](https://www.hypermarker.eu/).
- I serve as a Task Force member of the [European Heart Academy](posts/eha-2025/index.qmd) and edit the SCMR Journal Watch for the Society for Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance.
:::
